ar: خلدين فيها لا يخفف عنهم ٱلعذاب ولا هم ينظرون
tgt: They will abide therein (Hell). Neither will their torment be lightened, nor will it be delayed or postponed (for a while)

ar: ولقد جاءكم موسى بٱلبينت ثم ٱتخذتم ٱلعجل من بعده وانتم ظلمون

ar: وتٱلله لاكيدن اصنمكم بعد ان تولوا مدبرين
tgt: And by Allah, I shall plot a plan (to destroy) your idols after you have gone away and turned your backs
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: واذ قال موسى لقومه يقوم انكم ظلمتم انفسكم بٱتخاذكم ٱلعجل فتوبوا الى باريكم فٱقتلوا انفسكم ذلكم خير لكم عند باريكم فتاب عليكم انه هو ٱلتواب ٱلرحيم
tgt: And (remember) when Musa (Moses) said to his people: "O my people! Verily, you have wronged yourselves by worshipping the calf. So turn in repentance to your Creator and kill yourselves (the innocent kill the wrongdoers among you), that will be better for you with your Lord." Then He accepted your repentance. Truly, He is the One Who accepts repentance, the Most Merciful
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: واسمعيل وٱليسع ويونس ولوط ا وكل ا فضلنا على ٱلعلمين
tgt: And Isma'il (Ishmael) and Al-Yas'a (Elisha), and Yunus (Jonah) and Lout (Lot), and each one of them We preferred above the 'Alamin (mankind and jinns) (of their times)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: وسارعوا الى مغفرة من ربكم وجنة عرضها ٱلسموت وٱلارض اعدت للمتقين
tgt: And march forth in the way (which leads to) forgiveness from your Lord, and for Paradise as wide as are the heavens and the earth, prepared for Al-Muttaqun (the pious - see V)

ar: فلما اتىها نودي من شطي ٱلواد ٱلايمن في ٱلبقعة ٱلمبركة من ٱلشجرة ان يموسى اني انا ٱلله رب ٱلعلمين
tgt: So when he reached it (the fire), he was called from the right side of the valley, in the blessed place from the tree: "O Musa (Moses)! Verily! I am Allah, the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: كتب عليكم اذا حضر احدكم ٱلموت ان ترك خيرا ٱلوصية للولدين وٱلاقربين بٱلمعروف حقا على ٱلمتقين
tgt: It is prescribed for you, when death approaches any of you, if he leaves wealth, that he make a bequest to parents and next of kin, according to reasonable manners. (This is) a duty upon Al-Muttaqun (the pious - see V)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: اوليك لم يكونوا معجزين في ٱلارض وما كان لهم من دون ٱلله من اولياء يضعف لهم ٱلعذاب ما كانوا يستطيعون ٱلسمع وما كانوا يبصرون
tgt: By no means will they escape (from Allah's Torment) on earth, nor have they protectors besides Allah! Their torment will be doubled! ar: ربنا ٱكشف عنا ٱلعذاب انا مومنون
tgt: (They will say): "Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we shall become believers
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: ولوطا اذ قال لقومه اتاتون ٱلفحشة ما سبقكم بها من احد من ٱلعلمين
tgt: And (remember) Lout (Lot), when he said to his people: "Do you commit the worst sin such as none preceding you has committed in the 'Alamin (mankind and jinns)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: قل اونبيكم بخير من ذلكم للذين ٱتقوا عند ربهم جنت تجري من تحتها ٱلانهر خلدين فيها وازوج مطهرة ورضون من ٱلله وٱلله بصير بٱلعباد
tgt: Say: "Shall I inform you of things far better than those? For Al-Muttaqun (the pious - see V. 2:2) there are Gardens (Paradise) with their Lord, underneath which rivers flow. license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: ٱلذين كانت اعينهم في غطاء عن ذكري وكانوا لا يستطيعون سمعا
tgt: (To) Those whose eyes had been under a covering from My Reminder (this Quran), and who could not bear to hear (it)
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: وما تلك بيمينك يموسى

ar: كم تركوا من جنت وعيون‏

ar: يسلونك عن ٱلانفال قل ٱلانفال لله وٱلرسول فٱتقوا ٱلله واصلحوا ذات بينكم واطيعوا ٱلله ورسوله ان كنتم مومنين
tgt: They ask you (O Muhammad SAW) about the spoils of war. Say: "The spoils are for Allah and the Messenger." So fear Allah and adjust all matters of difference among you, and obey Allah and His Messenger (Muhammad SAW), if you are believers

ar: افحسب ٱلذين كفروا ان يتخذوا عبادي من دوني اولياء انا اعتدنا جهنم للكفرين نزل ا
tgt: Do then those who disbelieve think that they can take My slaves [i.e., the angels, Allah's Messengers, 'Iesa (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary), etc.] as Auliya' (lords, gods, protectors, etc.) besides Me? ar: وانهم يقولون ما لا يفعلون

tgt: And they say: "Why does this Messenger (Muhammad SAW) eat food, and walk about in the markets (like ourselves). Why is not an angel sent down to him to be a warner with him

tgt: And (remember) when We made the House (the Ka'bah at Makkah) a place of resort for mankind and a place of safety. tgt: And to the Madyan (Midian) people (We sent) their brother Shu'aib. He said: "O my people! Worship Allah, you have no other Ilah (God) but Him, and give not short measure or weight, I see you in prosperity; and verily I fear for you the torment of a Day encompassing

tgt: And let not those grieve you (O Muhammad SAW) who rush with haste to disbelieve; verily, not the least harm will they do to Allah. It is Allah's Will to give them no portion in the Hereafter. For them there is a great torment

tgt: So they returned with Grace and Bounty from Allah. No harm touched them; and they followed the good Pleasure of Allah. And Allah is the Owner of Great Bounty

tgt: So keep your duty to Allah and fear Him as much as you can; listen and obey; and spend in charity, that is better for yourselves. And whosoever is saved from his own covetousness, then they are the successful ones

tgt: Say (to them O Muhammad SAW): "Sufficient is Allah for a witness between me and you. He knows what is in the heavens and on earth." And those who believe in Batil (all false deities other than Allah), and disbelieve in Allah and (in His Oneness), it is they who are the losers
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body

ar: وٱلذين كفروا لهم نار جهنم لا يقضى عليهم فيموتوا ولا يخفف عنهم من عذابها كذلك نجزي كل كفور‏
tgt: But those who disbelieve, (in the Oneness of Allah - Islamic Monotheism) for them will be the Fire of Hell. Neither it will have a complete killing effect on them so that they die, nor shall its torment be lightened for them. Thus do We requite every disbeliever
license: Unlicense (aggregator); translator=Muhammad Taqi Ud Din Al Hilali And Muhammad Muhsin Khan; source approved as government/waqf body
